notes.title: World of relish - Uncensored version release
notes.notes:
If you liked this game and you want to get to know these cute and charming girls better, this DLC
is especially for you! 20 new illustrations with interesting content, have a nice time!

notes.title: World of Relish - Mini patch
notes.notes: This patch fixes the problem where some computer configurations were subjected to a heavy load on the CPU.

notes.title: World of Relish - Release!
notes.notes: We are pleased to inform you that [b]World of Relish[/b] is now available for sale! Will you be able to help these beautiful and sweet girls in their hard work? Make yourself comfortable, there are many kinds of minigames and puzzles waiting for you, enjoy!ːsteamhappyː
